title: Digitized dataset of aqueous acid dissociation constants
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,21397-21412
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02418A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jonathan W. Zheng, Olivier Lafontant-Joseph, William H. Green
A dataset containing 24 000+ entries of acid dissociation constant (pKa) measurements was digitized and made publicly available, alongside a machine learning model for predicting macroscopic pKa values.
